comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks gripper hardware; PR-2133 measures tyre tread depth with a friction-held pen gauge.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coupled rotational tools and countertorque; PR-2133 requires placing a probe on a groove floor while seating a foot across ribs, then withdrawing without changing the reading.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retained angular adjustment after cycles; PR-2133 grades a reading within 1/32 inch after valid seating and return of the gauge to its rest.
comparison.reason: Both preserve a setting during withdrawal in a broad sense, but only the candidate tests locknut-induced disturbance and retained articulated motion.
